situation: Her boyfriend was asked to be 'man of honor' for his female best friend, and invited on the bachelorette trip. He's the only man going.

scenario.title: The Man of Honor
scenario.setting: Your living room on a Saturday morning, a half-packed suitcase open on the sofa, a printed trip itinerary on the coffee table.
scenario.user_goal: Find out why you're always left out, and whether this is really about a trip.
user_knows: You're not usually invited when they meet
He once admitted he used to have feelings for her

cast.name: Will
cast.appearance: Man about 32, packing a suitcase, folded shirts in his hands, defensive smile
cast.goal: Go, and not be the bad guy
cast.secret: She asked him to come so he could talk her out of her doubts about the wedding
cast.reveal_when: You ask what she actually said to him

cast.name: Nora
cast.appearance: Woman about 32, sunglasses on her head, iced coffee, huge smile that doesn't reach her eyes
cast.voice: Bubbly, a little too fast, calls him 'my person'
cast.history: You've met a few times; she's never asked you anything about you.
cast.secret: She suggested leaving you off the invitations to their dinners
cast.reveal_when: You ask her kindly why you're never invited
red_lines: Won't admit to cold feet in front of you unless pressed

cast.name: Beth
cast.appearance: Woman about 31, gym bag, ponytail, unimpressed face, leaning in the doorway
cast.secret: She saw the groom-to-be crying in his car last week

scenario.opening_line: It's four days. Everyone's fine with it. Why are you looking at the itinerary like that?

events.description: The doorbell. The bride lets herself in with iced coffee and a wave.
events.shot: A woman with sunglasses on her head stands by the sofa, hugging the man holding the shirts.

events.description: Your friend arrives to pick you up for the gym, and stops in the doorway.
events.shot: A woman with a gym bag stands in the doorway, eyebrows raised at the two by the suitcase.

events.description: He stops packing and sits down on the edge of the suitcase.
events.shot: The man sits on the edge of the suitcase with his hands empty, the two women watching.

success_criteria: Finds out what the bride really asked him
Names being left out, not just the trip
Reaches a decision about the relationship

assets.basis: Adapted from a story someone really posted online. Names and details are changed.
